body: Brian, via the Windows window at 2026-09-25 14:42 EDT, asks for the Mac node's model settings: please reply with h9k config show's model and effort lines (default-model, effort, every model (<role>) row with its origin, orchestrator-model) and any per-project --model or --orchestrator-model override on the Mac's projects.
